Loaded NPCs are restored immediately when safe; unloaded/sleeping NPCs are queued and restored on a later load. The queue and managed-NPC registry are saved in the SKSE cosave, so cleanup can continue after save/reload. Remove or disable unwanted rules/packs first if you do not want OD to manage those NPCs again later.

json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.accessories.help: Accessories are independent entries such as hoods, cloaks, wigs, backpacks, masks or jewelry. Add only the entries you need; advanced dependency and persistence settings stay out of the way until opened.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.accessories.subtitle: Optional additive items worn over the selected outfit.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.accessories.title: Accessories
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.accessory_id_help: Optional name for this accessory entry. Give it an ID only when another accessory needs to depend on it.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.accessory_mode_help: Explicit items builds a weighted pool from specific ARMO/LVLI records. Plugin + slot builds a pool from playable armor in one plugin that uses the chosen biped slot.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.accessory_rotation_help: The main outfit stays fixed. This value still controls normal accessory rotation timing.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.add_accessory_help: Creates one independent accessory entry with its own chance and item pool.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.ammunition_help: Select arrows or bolts for Single Weapon rules. OD picks one compatible AMMO entry once per NPC and ensures the NPC owns at least the configured quantity.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.armor_list_help: Loads playable ARMO records so Outfit Distributor can build the plugin + biped-slot pool. The list stays cached for the current session.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.biped_slot_help: Skyrim biped slots identify equipment areas. Valid slots are 30-61. Modded equipment may use the higher slots differently by convention, and one armor record can occupy several slots at once.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.build_json_preview_help: Builds the exact rule JSON through the existing Rule Wizard backend without writing a file.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.cell_help: Use Cell for a very specific interior or exterior cell. Only the NPC's exact current parent cell matches; this is narrower than Location.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.chance_to_distribute_help: Rolled once per NPC and persisted in the OD cosave. If the roll fails, OD remembers that result instead of rerolling on every refresh.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.chance_to_equip_help: 100% always attempts to use this accessory entry; 0% never equips it.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.climate_help_full: Cold climate uses Outfit Distributor's native region/weather analysis. Exterior regions count as cold when snow-classified weather has enough weight. Interior cells do not match the cold-climate condition.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.climate_help_short: Cold climate uses Outfit Distributor's native region/weather analysis. Interior cells do not match the cold-climate condition.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.conditions.help: Conditions are optional filters evaluated in game. Combine them only when you want a rule to apply in a specific place, climate, weather, season or time window.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.conditions.subtitle: Choose where and when this rule can run. Leave everything empty for no restriction.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.conditions.title: Conditions
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.current_outfit_help: Targets the original outfit memorized before OD replacement (JSON: currentOutfit). If SkyPatcher, SPID or another mod changed it before the first OD snapshot, that initial runtime outfit is memorized.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.current_outfit_hint: Match the original outfit memorized by OD before replacement.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.delete_json_help: This removes '%s' and every rule stored in it. Outfit Distributor creates a .bak backup first, reloads its configurations and refreshes affected loaded actors.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.delete_rule_help: This removes the selected rule from '%s'. Other rules and file settings are preserved. A .bak backup is created first; if this is the last rule, the JSON file is kept with an empty rules array.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.detailed_selections_hint: Open this only when you want to verify the exact forms selected in each section.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.distribution_settings_hin: Optional controls for persistence, rotation, chance and conflict handling.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.dual_wield_help: Dual Wield supports one-handed swords, daggers, war axes, maces and staffs. The backend validator rejects incompatible weapon types before saving.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.dynamic_weapon_condition_: Dynamic Weapon Rules are reevaluated when OD refreshes the NPC. Leaving their conditions restores displaced equipment before switching to another Weapon Rule.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.edit_intro: Choose a JSON file and a rule in the Source / Edit panel on the left, then load it. The Native UI will import all supported fields and keep unknown JSON fields through the existing Rule Wizard backend.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.equipped_weapon_type_help: This is a condition, not weapon distribution. Leave every box unchecked to ignore equipped weapon type. It cannot be combined with a Weapon Rule output.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.equipped_weapon_type_hint: only match NPCs currently using these weapon types
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.exclude_location_keyword_: Use this as a negative location filter. Example: a backpack rule can run broadly but be blocked in locations tagged as cities or towns.
Prevent the rule from running in locations with selected keywords.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.exclusion_category_help: Choose what kind of record to exclude. Original Outfit excludes the outfit memorized by OD before replacement (JSON: excludeCurrentOutfit), including changes made by other mods before OD's first snapshot.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.exclusions.help: Exclusions always win over matching targets. Use them to protect specific NPCs or groups that should never receive this rule even when the other conditions match.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.exclusions.subtitle: Anything selected here is excluded from this rule.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.exclusions.title: Exclusions
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.existing_outfit_conflict_: Override lets this rule take control. Skip leaves an NPC already claimed by another OD rule unchanged.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.explicit_outfits_help: Use this when you know the exact outfit records you want in the pool. Multiple selected outfits give OD several possible choices.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.faction_rank_filters_help: Use this when faction membership alone is too broad. Multiple faction-rank filters use the All/Any match mode above.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.faction_rank_filters_hint: Require faction membership with an optional minimum and/or maximum rank.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.gender_help: Restricts the rule by the NPC's sex. 'Any' leaves gender unrestricted.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.hand_help: Only applies to Single Weapon. Auto lets Skyrim choose the compatible hand; Right or Left requests that specific hand.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.import_npc_help: Imports the currently targeted NPC as a persistent NPC target. Leveled/runtime actors are resolved to a stable base or template when possible.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.initial_equip_help: When enabled, OD requests initial equip and reasserts the loadout at combat start. Shield Only never forces an incompatible weapon out of a hand.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.interior_help: Choose whether the rule can match everywhere, only inside interior cells, or only outside.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.intro: Build the rule in 7 simple sections. Optional settings stay collapsed until you need them.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.is_unique_help: Unique NPCs are named or individually defined actors. 'Any' adds no restriction; 'Unique only' writes isUnique=true; 'Non-unique only' writes isUnique=false.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.item_pool_help: Weight 2 is twice as likely as weight 1. Several source plugins can be mixed in the same pool.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.item_pool_hint: ARMO and LVLI, with optional weights
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.keyword_rank_match_help: When several keyword or faction-rank filters are used, 'All' requires every filter to match. 'Any' allows a match when at least one does.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.loadout_mode_help: Single Weapon distributes one primary weapon and can also distribute ammunition. Dual Wield uses a primary right-hand pool plus an off-hand pool. Weapon + Shield uses a compatible one-handed primary weapon plus a shield. Shield Only preserves existing weapons and only manages the shield.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.location_help: Location uses the NPC's current BGSLocation. Selecting a broader location can also cover its child locations, making it useful for holds, towns or other location hierarchies.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.location_hint: Match a location and its nested child locations.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.location_keyword_help: Use location keywords for broad categories such as city, town or settlement instead of naming one specific location.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.location_keyword_hint: Require the current location to carry selected keywords.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.max_npcs_per_outfit_help: Limits how many NPCs may share the same distributed outfit. 0 means unlimited.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.maximum_level_help: Highest NPC level allowed to match this rule. 0 means no maximum level restriction.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.minimum_level_help: Lowest NPC level allowed to match this rule. 0 means no minimum level restriction.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.multiple_weapons_ammo_hel: Adds each selected ammunition type that is compatible with a bow or crossbow in the bundle. Count is the minimum stack per compatible AMMO entry.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.multiple_weapons_equip_he: Initially equips one weapon if needed, then Skyrim AI can switch between the weapons in inventory. OD does not reassert a fixed weapon at combat start.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.multiple_weapons_help: Adds one copy of every selected weapon if missing and keeps existing equipment. The NPC AI chooses its combat weapon; equip styles and ammo compatibility still apply.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.no_accessory: No accessory configured. This step is optional.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.optional_target_filters_h: Use these only when Targets alone are too broad.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.original_residents_help: Requires original placement OR a declared fixed AI assignment in the selected Cell, Worldspace and Location. Supports fixed posts, isolated/linked patrol markers, direct references, sandbox/sit/idle/sleep templates (including SleepAndGuard), and resolved reference aliases in running quests. Permanent guard posts without package conditions are supported, including their fixed Travel destination. Current-position filters still apply. Moving actors, follow/ordinary travel destinations, package-start/current positions and unresolved Location aliases are not residence evidence. Mod templates must inherit a recognized routine or use a supported package type. Sleep outfits and package execution are unchanged. Location keyword filters are unaffected.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.original_residents_requir: Select a Cell, Worldspace or Location for this option.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.outfit_formlists_help: Select a FormList that contains outfit references. This is useful when another mod already groups compatible outfits in a list.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.outfit_formlists_hint: Use a FLST as an outfit source.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.outfit_plugins_help: Adds an outfit source by plugin instead of selecting each OUTF record manually. Useful for outfit packs dedicated to distribution.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.outfit_plugins_hint: Use outfit records discovered from an entire plugin.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.outfits.help: This page defines the outfit pool produced by the rule. You may combine several source types; Outfit Distributor will keep their existing weighting and validation behavior when the JSON is built.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.outfits.subtitle: Choose the outfit pool. Start with Explicit outfits; the other sources are optional.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.outfits.title: Outfits
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.persistent_outfit_help: Pick one outfit per NPC and keep that choice across days and saves. Sleep outfits and accessories keep their own selection behavior.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.persistent_selection_help: Keeps the same valid accessory choice for this NPC across days, cell changes and save/reload.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.plugin_no_outfits: Plugin loaded; no usable outfits detected
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.plugin_slot_help: Plugin + slot builds a random pool from playable armor records in this plugin that use the selected biped slot.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.rank_invalid: Minimum rank is higher than maximum rank.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.replace_duplicate_help: Replace and duplicate create a .bak backup and preserve file-level settings plus unknown rule fields.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.replace_restore_conflicts: Temporarily removes conflicting armor, equips the accessory, then restores the displaced armor when the accessory no longer applies. Useful for dynamic rain or snow accessories.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.requires_help: When set, this accessory is considered only if the accessory entry with that ID was selected first.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.review.help: The Rule Wizard backend validator runs before preview and before save. Editing preserves fields that the Native UI does not modify.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.review.subtitle: Check the complete rule, preview its JSON and choose how it should be saved.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.review.title: Review & Save
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.review_summary_line: Level %d-%d   |   Rotation %d day%s   |   Vanilla chance %d%%   |   Weather %s
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.rotation_days_help: Number of in-game days an outfit assignment is kept before a new roll is allowed. 1 allows daily rotation.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.rule_name_help: Human-readable name stored in the rule.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.runtime_conflict_help: Controls what OD does if another mod changes the NPC's default outfit later. Override takes control back; Respect keeps the external change.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.season_help: Runs the rule only during the selected seasons. If no season is selected, season does not restrict the rule.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.shield_only_pool_help: OD chooses one playable shield ARMO from this pool while preserving all existing weapons. If the hands are incompatible, the shield remains in inventory.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.shield_only_preserves: Shield Only preserves all existing weapons. No primary weapon pool is required.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.sleep_outfits_help: Sleep outfits are separate from the normal daytime outfit pool and are applied while the NPC is sleeping according to OD's native sleep-outfit behavior.

json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.weapons.help: Weapon output is optional and can share a rule with outfits, sleep outfits and accessories. Weapon Rules support location, cell, location keywords, interior/exterior, time, climate, weather, season and level conditions. Displaced weapons and shields are restored before another Weapon Rule is applied, or when no Weapon Rule matches. Equipped Weapon Type conditions remain forbidden because the distributed weapon would change its own condition.

json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.weather_help_short: Runs the rule only during the selected weather categories. Selecting several categories means any selected category may match.
json:other_translation/outfit-distributo.strings.wizard.workshop_outfits_help: Workshop entries can be combined in one pool. Weight 2 makes an entry twice as likely as weight 1, weight 3 three times as likely, and so on.
